completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5592_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of San Patricio, Abulao and Barangobong are separated from the barrio of Magallanes in the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan, and constituted into a new separate and independent barrio to be known as the barrio of Barangobong in the said municipality and province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
